figures.caption: SAXS data showing the scattered intensity plotted towards the modulus of the scattering vector, q for 10-mer peptoids at 5 mg/mL obtained at BM29, ESRF at 37 °C. (A) displays the fully halogenated and (B) includes half-halogenated peptoids. The non-halogenated peptoid 19 is included in both graphs as a reference. Results indicate predominantly free unstructured peptoid chains with a small fraction of sheet-like filaments for compounds 19–21 and 24–27, and defined bundles for compounds 22 and 23, seen as an increase in the scattering intensity and a change in shape of the curve.
figures.label: Figure 2
